title: Two Names for One Fire · side B
description: A storyteller at a fire and the creature in the story are the same animal: the tale is whispered on a reed over hands and clay, and when the drum calls it by its other name it comes out of the dark at one and a half times the speed.

sections.development: the same tale at one and a half times the speed, barked; no build, the downbeat is the arrival
half-time floor: a wet finger moans on the skin, then one reed howl cracks upward
the tale returns feral; the only new thing is the hands, now inside the stomp
the teller alone again, whispering the tale home
